description: Tutorial lesson T2 (Musterin' da Boyz) step 6 of 11, 'PARK DA WAGON!' (deploy_wagon), on a GAMEPAD. Reported: the step re-opened with 'Tap RB till da Battlewagon row is picked' even though step 5 (rotate_wagon) can only tick once the player has ALREADY picked the wagon up and turned its ghost - so the pad player was told to redo the thing they were mid-way through, which reads as 'you did it wrong'. This scenario boots T2, drives it mouse+keyboard as far as the rotate, then flips the card to its PAD body at deploy_wagon while the ghost is genuinely still in hand, and asserts the rendered prompt: no bumper chips at all, and the A + left-stick chips plus a drop verb are present. It then finishes the step on pad input only (A warps the cursor, glide, A drops) to prove the prompt the player is reading is a complete instruction on its own.

steps.script:
var ids = []
for s in TutorialManager._steps:
	ids.append(str(s.get("id", "")))
return ids.find("deploy_wagon") + 1
steps.comment: the reported step number: TutorialManager renders 'Step %d / %d' off current_step_index + 1, so deploy_wagon really is the player-visible step 6
OptionButton popup menus are native windows - select+emit is the dropdown escape hatch
the Formations panel is a modal embedded Window - synthetic root-viewport clicks cannot reach its controls; setting button_pressed emits toggled exactly like a click
tie tolerance: press the roll button if still up, else the A DEAD HEAT re-roll button; no-op when neither exists
rotate_right = +15 degrees a tap, so six taps is a quarter turn - this is what ticks rotate_wagon

steps.script:
var dc = tree.root.get_node("Main").deployment_controller
return str(dc.unit_id) == "U_BATTLEWAGON_T" and dc.get_placed_count() == 0 and dc.ghost_sprite != null
steps.comment: THE PREMISE OF THE FIX: reaching step 6 means the wagon is already picked and its ghost is in hand, un-dropped. A prompt that opens by telling the player to pick it is describing work they have already done.
the mouse+keyboard body no longer re-names the Battlewagon row either - it just says where to click

flip the card to its PAD body in exactly the state the reported player was in: step 6 open, wagon in hand. Uses the claim_pad() seam rather than a stick nudge because a real axis event drags the virtual cursor and edge-pushes the camera.

THE FIX (reported: 'step 6 repeats the instruction to press RB or LB until the battlewagon is picked'): NEITHER bumper chip appears in the step 6 pad body any more. Reads the chips off GlyphDB rather than hardcoding 'RB'/'LB' so a controller remap keeps the assertion honest.
and the row it told the player to go re-pick is not named either - no 'till da Battlewagon row is picked' tail survives in any wording
what is LEFT is a complete instruction: glide the left stick into the zone and press A to drop it
A warps the virtual cursor over the board - the first half of what the prompt now says
A drops it - the second half. No bumper was pressed anywhere in this block.
step 6 completes on pad input only, following the trimmed prompt literally
